title: Normalized change of site intertwines abelian h-maps
statement: Let X,Y be quasi-compact separated schemes, aX,aY normalized abelian-Zariski-to-lifted-etale cohomology equivalences, g:Y→X, quasi-coherent F,G and psi:g*F→G. Given an etale sheaf map theta with the structural qcoherentPullbackSection component formula, aY after zariskiModuleHMap of the tensor adjoint of psi equals the etale inverse-image cohomology map followed by the cohomology map of the adjoint of theta, after aX. Both Zariski groups and the map are abelian Ext; no module-derived map is involved. This does not construct theta. Notions: [def-pc-scheme], [pqf-def-coherent], [def-pbc-canonical-coherent-etale-comparison], [lem-weil-pbc-qcoherent-pullback-sections-map], [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback], [def-pbc-qcoherent-zariski-cohomology-map].

proof.text: Obtain the two exact comparison presentations and the sheaf-level inverse-image isomorphism with its integer and coefficient triangles. This step has no positive-degree cohomology.

The exact presentations induce normalized delta-functor maps. Quasi-coherent effacement and normalized uniqueness identify them with aX and aY. The proof uses the explicit Eq on values, not arbitrary choices of cohomology isomorphisms.

Apply the proved exactComparison_hmap_square API to the chosen presentations and their integer and coefficient triangles. This combines exact-functor naturality and Ext associativity without unfolding the large bundled maps in this theorem.

theorem normalizedAbelianEtale_hmap_square
    (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [Scheme.IsSeparated X]
    [CompactSpace Y] [Scheme.IsSeparated Y]
    (aX : ∀ (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (q : ℕ),
      CoherentEtale.Source X F q ≃+ CoherentEtale.Target X F q)
    (aY : ∀ (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsQuasicoherent] (q : ℕ),
      CoherentEtale.Source Y G q ≃+ CoherentEtale.Target Y G q)
    (haX : IsNormalizedCoherentEtaleComparison X aX)
    (haY : IsNormalizedCoherentEtaleComparison Y aY)
    (g : Y ⟶ X) (F : X.Modules) (G : Y.Modules)
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] [G.IsQuasicoherent] (ψ : (tensorPullback g).obj F ⟶ G)
    (θ : liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf F ⟶
      (Etale.lowerStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).obj (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf G))
    (hθ : ∀ (U : X.Etale) (s : (etaleTensorSectionsSheaf F).obj.obj (op U)),
      θ.hom.app (op U) (ULift.up s) = ULift.up
        (qcoherentPullbackSection g F G ψ U
          ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @AlgebraicGeometry.Etale ⊤ g).obj U)
          (pullback.fst U.hom g) pullback.condition s))
    (q : ℕ) (x : CoherentEtale.Source X F q) :
    aY G q (zariskiModuleHMap g
      ((Classical.choose (exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction g)).homEquiv F G ψ) q x) =
      Sheaf.H.map
        ((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g).homEquiv
          (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf F) (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf G) |>.symm θ)
        q (Etale.cohomologyMap g (liftedCoherentEtaleSheaf F) q (aX F q x))
